crossRefs.note: Look! Praise Yahweh, all you servants of Yahweh, who stand by night in Yahweh’s house!
you who stand in Yahweh’s house, in the courts of our God’s house.

people.name: Holy_Place
people.line: The inner sanctuary of the Tabernacle and Temple

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: Stand in the holy place according to the divisions of the fathers’ houses of your brothers the children of the people, and let there be for each a portion of a fathers’ house of the Levites.
translations.bsb: Moreover, stand in the Holy Place by the divisions of the families of your kinsmen the lay people, and by the divisions of the families of the Levites.
translations.kjv: And stand in the holy place according to the divisions of the families of the fathers of your brethren the people, and after the division of the families of the Levites.
translations.asv: And stand in the holy place according to the divisions of the fathers' houses of your brethren the children of the people, and let there be for each a portion of a fathers' house of the Levites.
